DESCRIPTION_KR: Scientific Name: Ricinus Communis Origin: West Africa Jamaican Black Castor Oil (JBCO) is a traditional castor oil brought to Jamaica via the transatlantic slave trade. Unlike pale cold-pressed castor oil, JBCO is made by roasting and boiling seeds, yielding a dark brown, smoky oil with slightly higher alkalinity from ash. Rich in Ric inoleic acid (Omega-9) , JBCO is a potent emollient that nourishes the scalp, supports hair thickness, maintains skin hydration, and shows mild anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activity. Key differences: Appearance : conventional — pale; JBCO — dark. Extraction : conventional — cold-pressed/solvent; JBCO — roasted and boiled. pH : conventional — slightly acidic; JBCO — more alkaline. Common uses: Supports hair growth and thickness Moisturizes scalp Reduces breakage and split ends Conditions lashes and brows Soothes dry skin and chapped lips Helps improve appearance of scars

Every touch reminded me of my connection with nature, of the cycle of life that goes on forever.”  Michał Gilbert Lach

DESCRIPTION_KR: An anti-explosion perfume mixing machine is a specialized equipment used in the perfume industry for blending and mixing fragrances safely. The capacity can be 50-2000L.Its primary purpose is to combine different perfume ingredients, such as essential oils and aromatic compounds, to create a desired fragrance composition. The "anti-explosion" feature refers to safety measures taken to prevent any potential explosion risks. Perfume ingredients, especially those with high volatility or flammability, can pose safety hazards if not handled properly. Hence, anti-explosion mixing machines are designed with safety features like explosion-proof materials, spark-resistant components, and proper ventilation systems to minimize the risk of explosions or fires. The use of an anti-explosion perfume mixing machine ensures the safety of personnel working with flammable perfume ingredients and helps maintain a controlled and efficient production process in the perfume industry.

A component for perfumes & attars which are used for body sprays. e. For applications in insecticide sprays, in oiling of textile fabrics, in paper varnishes, floor coverings, etc. We can also provide DEP as per BP/EP/USP for pharmaceutical applications. The process ensures the collagen reaches its full potential in terms of absorption and effectiveness.

From there, the scent drifts to Tahaa in Polynesia, for its rich, intoxicating vanilla. The heart of the fragrance is a creamy panna cotta that blends tenderly with mango curd, creating a harmonious dessert-like accord. Designed for those who crave gourmand luxury, Pannaco Tahaa is an homage to indulgence, travel, and sweet memories.

DESCRIPTION_KR: Esco Pazzo was an exercise in patience and perseverance. Lorenzo Pazzaglia pictured the fragrance perfectly in his mind’s eye, but creating it was a whole other thing. He stuck at it, somewhat doggedly, refusing to give up. And he did it: the idea became a reality. The scintillating opening of lemon, cedar, bergamot and grapefruit, together with pepper, creates a brilliant burst of freshness, ushering in a spicy aromatic heart. The dry down reveals a velvety base of leather, tobacco and amber. Esco Pazzo is a modern twist on the classic structure of fougère fragrances, enhanced with oriental hints and amber nuances. Over fifty raw ingredients are blended to create this modern, elegant and chameleon-like fragrance. DESCRIPTION_KR: The belissima rossa eau de parfum pays tribute to Italian dolce vita – sun-drenched days on the Amalfi Coast, the gentle sound of waves and the carefree lightness of being. The opening sparkles with joie de vivre – a whiff of summer. Lively bergamot is reminiscent of the freshness of a sun-drenched citrus grove, while juicy mango and exotic passion fruit capture the sweetness of ripe fruit. At the heart, a seductive blend of salty vanilla and creamy ylang-ylang unfolds – like a light and airy dessert in a small Italian pasticceria by the sea. Delicate rose petals add romantic elegance to the composition, while soft lactones evoke sun-kissed skin after a day at the beach. The base note envelops the senses with noble, blending warm sandalwood and soft cashmere wood, as well as ambergris. The fragrance is rounded off with the gentle sweetness of vanilla, which lingers on the skin for a long time.

DESCRIPTION_KR: L’Oud Marin is a meeting of elements. It is a dialogue between salt and smoke, tide and timber. The scent captures the quiet violence of a post-storm shore. Sea-drenched wood crackles underfoot. The air hums with mineral tension. The opening is cold and bracing. Atlantic Seaweed and a rare in-house kombu tincture bring a rush of saline intensity. This is not a stylized breeze. It is the sea itself — wild and organic. At the heart lies a tapestry of dark botanicals. Haitian Amyris lends a smoky glow. Honduran Styrax adds a tarry resinous depth. Indian Nagarmotha brings earthy dryness. Madagascan Cacao Absolute evokes storm-scorched wood — bitter, dry, elemental. The base anchors the memory. Kinam Oud from Hainan is the soul — dense and meditative. Ambergris tincture swirls around it, with a blend of black and white. Warm beeswax softens the edges. Madagascar Vanilla, Virginia Cedarwood, and Indian Vetiver bring golden smoky warmth — like sunlight after the flood.

Overcome with love one day, the King commissioned a secret garden, near a secluded grotto, for his beloved Queen. A hidden oasis filled with rare flowers from the New World, this private sanctuary became a living symbol of their love: exotic, precious, and enduring. Floreal is an olfactory reverie, capturing the giddy magic of love’s full bloom. Each delicate note wraps you in the feeling of being adored, echoing the romance and beauty of a love story written just for you. Notes: Peach, Bergamot, Tuberose, Ylang-Ylang, Jasmine, Labdanum, Cedarwood

DESCRIPTION_KR: The gentle breezes from Valencia whispered tales of “Conquista” to the humble artisan, revealing the legend known only to mariners who ferry the city's citrus treasures across distant waters. At the break of dawn, expert hands move through Valencia’s misty groves, harvesting oranges at the pinnacle of their perfection. Each fruit, carefully plucked, releases a sweet, invigorating aroma that fills the air so potently that it helps lost sailors navigate home even in the thickest of fog. Once loaded onto wooden boats, the real magic begins: the citrus fragrance mingles with the ocean breeze as the vessels glide toward the shimmering horizon, carrying this fragrant symphony to the rest of the world. Conquista embodies the spirit of these Valencian oranges, symbolizing new beginnings and how embracing one’s authentic self can unlock limitless potential. Notes: Lemon, Bergamot, Cinnamon, Orange Flower, Cypress, Madagascar Vanilla Bourbon, Tonka Bean

NAME_KR: Face Facts Ceramide Skin Barrier Complex
NAME_EN: Face Facts Ceramide Skin Barrier Complex
DESCRIPTION_KR: The Ceramide range from Face Facts harnesses an innovative skin barrier complex comprising of five ceramides, hyaluronic acid, and oats. Hailed as one of the best soothing skincare ingredients, Ceramides are, simply put, lipids (oils) that occur naturally in the skin. They help to maintain the skin barrier, retain hydration, and keep out unwanted elements, like bacteria, by sealing the gaps between the skin cells. If skin cells are bricks, then ceramides are the mortar that holds them together. They help to keep the skin looking healthy, firm, and plump, however, when it is dehydrated, irritated or ageing, the naturally occurring ceramides in the skin deplete. Applying the ceramides range can help to replenish those lost and support the skin’s natural barrier, resulting in a smoother, calmer, and softer complexion. Expertly formulated for all skin types, including dry and sensitive, this effective skincare range is dermatologically tested and is also fragrance-free and vegan-friendly.

NAME_KR: Activated Charcoal Detox & Cleanse Face Wash

Experience crystal clear & refreshed skin with Saeed Ghani's Activated Charcoal Face Wash. The soft and creamy texture is infused with powerful activated charcoal beads that work wonders on your skin. Activated charcoal acts as a magnet, effortlessly trapping pollutants, toxins, dirt, and impurities, leaving your skin feeling deeply purified and refreshed after each use. Enjoy cleaner, radiant skin. Cautions: Perform a patch test prior to use. Discontinue if redness/irritation occurs.

DESCRIPTION_KR: SATIN Satin explores the tension between textures. A fragrance composed not just to be smelled, but to be felt intimately, instinctively. At its core is a tactile dialogue: the softness of a flower against the thickness of resin, the interplay of tenderness and boldness. It combines the airy, luminous lightness of peony with the dense, warm richness of labdanum. This is satin, not just in name but in sensation, leaving an indelible trace like the confident stroke of ink across handmade paper. It doesn’t announce itself. It glides. It stays. THIKRA THIKRA: Arabic word for Memory During our journey through life, we encounter people, take unexpected roads, and pass through places heavy with memory. While the eyes hold fleeting images, it is scent that remains, the true imprint of time. Cold spices blend with warm, smoky layers, grounded in ritual. Heart notes of palo santo and ebony evoke strength and presence. Thikra is not nostalgia. It is presence.

DESCRIPTION_KR: Rotary capper HP “High Performance” with 16 press-on capping heads and 16 servo plates with grippers. The servo plates allow the machine to perform the bottle orientation according to a pre-determined spot: the camera, with its flash, takes several photos of the bottle passing by and the plate automatically makes the bottle arrive into a certain position. In this case the camera detects the data matrix on the bottle and positions it in accordance. The second camera performs multiple controls: - Cap presence - Cap height (too high) - Capping within a certain tolerance between cap and bottle (here +/- 20°C) - Data matrix presence – visibility The third camera (optional) looks for the data matrix, the plate makes the bottle turn in order to have the spot right in front of the camera, and finally the camera decodes it.

DESCRIPTION_KR: AETERDERM PURIHILO PN is a skin booster containing HA (Hyaluronic Acid) and PN (Polynucleotide). It combines both high-molecular and low-molecular weight HA to enhance cohesiveness. Unlike other products, it binds HA without using BDDE (Butanediol diglycidyl ether) or heat treatment. As a result, there are no side effects from BDDE, and the ingredients are not damaged by heat. Additionally, while other products require multiple injection points on the face, causing significant discomfort, AETERDERM PURIHILO PN, which does not use BDDE, has excellent physical properties that allow for treatment with fewer injection points. The HA component provides moisturizing and brightening effects, while the PN component helps with wrinkle reduction, skin regeneration, and improved skin elasticity.

DESCRIPTION_KR: Buddha Wood Oil is a tenacious and unique essential oil distilled from a small desert tree native to Australia. Traditionally, its aromatic wood was burned for its grounding scent and valued by Indigenous Australians for its antibacterial qualities. Steam-distilled, the oil reveals a smoky, resinous aroma with earthy depth and subtle spice, rich in constituents such as eremophilone and closely related to the prized Agarwood. This dark copper-red, viscous oil offers a medium-intensity fragrance, smoked, woody, and sustained with a spicy undertone. Highly versatile, it is used as a base note in perfumery, skincare, and aromatherapy, where it enhances both blends and rituals. Buddha Wood Oil beautifully complements cedarwood, sandalwood, Peru balsam, rose, lavender, and ylang-ylang, making it a distinctive and grounding choice for fragrance and wellness creations.
